mapper.select: select id, season_no as seasonNo, level_no as levelNo, title, poem_title as poemTitle, poem_author as poemAuthor, size_n as sizeN, grid_json as gridJson, lines_json as linesJson, paths_json as pathsJson, difficulty from game_poem_maze_level where season_no = #{seasonNo} and level_no = #{levelNo} and status = 1 limit 1

select id, season_no as seasonNo, level_no as levelNo, title, poem_title as poemTitle, poem_author as poemAuthor, difficulty from game_poem_maze_level where season_no = #{seasonNo} and status = 1 order by sort_no asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into game_poem_maze_user_line ( user_id, season_no, level_id, level_no, poem_title, poem_author, line_index, line_text, score ) values ( #{userId}, #{seasonNo}, #{levelId}, #{levelNo}, #{poemTitle}, #{poemAuthor}, #{lineIndex}, #{lineText}, 1 )
mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.username as username, u.nickname as nickname, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, ifnull(r.totalScore, 0) as totalScore, ifnull(r.totalLines, 0) as totalLines, ifnull(r.solvedPoems, 0) as solvedPoems, r.latestSolveTime as latestSolveTime from sys_user u left join ( select user_id, sum(score) as totalScore, count(*) as totalLines, count(distinct level_id) as solvedPoems, date_format(max(created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as latestSolveTime from game_poem_maze_user_line where season_no = #{seasonNo} group by user_id ) r on u.id = r.user_id order by totalScore desc, totalLines desc, solvedPoems desc, latestSolveTime desc, u.id asc
